name: localflow
description: A locally-running AI filmmaking studio inspired by Google Flow.

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && cd backend && uv run localflow serve
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.typegen: cd backend && uv run localflow openapi -o ../frontend/src/api/openapi.json && cd ../frontend && npm run typegen
